Brushes out, pumpkins ready — Sunday's about to get messy and magical. 🎃🖌️

Jayme and Alejandro are taking over the Lounge for Pumpkin Painting Night, and this is the kind of Sunday that actually makes you glad the weekend isn't over yet. Grab a drink, grab a brush, and let your inner artist (or chaos gremlin) run wild on a pumpkin that's all yours to keep. 🧡

Best painted pumpkin walks away with a prize — so bring your A-game or just bring the vibes, either way you're winning. Tickets are limited and RSVP is required, so don't sleep on this one. 🎨

🗓️ Sunday, October 25 • Starting at 8PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ $10 Online — Must RSVP
🔞 21+

Soft lighting, orange pumpkins, paint-stained fingers and laughter spilling across the Lounge 🎃🧡

This is Pumpkin Painting Night — the clink of glasses, brushes dipping into paint, the hum of good conversation between strangers turning into friends. Jayme and Alejandro set the tone for a Sunday that feels less like an event and more like a cozy little escape with a drink in hand. 🍹

There's something about creating something with your hands while the night unwinds slow around you — it's the kind of evening that sticks with you long after the paint dries. And when the best pumpkin gets crowned? Pure chaos, pure joy. 🏆

Pumpkin Painting Night isn't about being the next Picasso, it's about carving out a little space with your people, your drink, and your pumpkin. Jayme and Alejandro are hosting the Lounge for a night that's chill, playful, and all about connection — new faces, familiar ones, everybody welcome at the table. 🫶

Whether you're painting something masterful or something hilariously questionable, you belong here. Stick around for the best pumpkin prize because somebody's walking away a legend. 🏆

This is what Sunday nights are made for — good company, better chaos. 💛
